scenes.headline: Auto Loader
scenes.subtitle: Incrementally ingest new files as they land
scenes.narration: Auto Loader efficiently and incrementally processes new files arriving in cloud storage without manual bookkeeping.

scenes.headline: Why Auto Loader exists
items: Detects only new files, never reprocessing old ones
Scales to millions of files efficiently
scenes.narration: Auto Loader tracks which files it has seen so it processes each one exactly once. It scales to directories with millions of files without slowing down. It can also infer the schema and adapt as new columns appear.

scenes.headline: Reading with cloudFiles
scenes.narration: The cloudFiles source reads new JSON files incrementally from the landing directory. A schema location persists the inferred schema and enables automatic evolution when new columns arrive. The availableNow trigger processes all pending files in one efficient batch and then stops.

scenes.headline: File notification vs directory listing

columns.title: Directory listing
points: Lists storage to find new files

scenes.narration: Directory listing mode simply scans the folder for new files and needs no extra setup. File notification mode subscribes to cloud storage events for far greater scale and lower cost. Auto Loader can switch between them as your volume grows.

scenes.headline: Best practices
items: Always set a stable schemaLocation and checkpoint
Use availableNow for scheduled incremental batches
Route bad records with rescued data column
scenes.narration: A persistent schema location and checkpoint make ingestion resilient and exactly-once. The availableNow trigger fits scheduled jobs that catch up and stop. The rescued data column safely captures fields that do not fit the schema.

scenes.text: Auto Loader gives you incremental, exactly-once file ingestion that just scales.
scenes.narration: Point it at a folder, and it handles discovery, schema, and state for you.
